tool_args.rationale: The pilot spans only H=0.16–0.48, while the target is H=20.4. The authorized mechanism and probe guidance identify slow adaptation as the decisive uncertainty.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not identify slow adaptation reliably at the target horizon of 20.4.
Fine short-horizon sampling is less directly informative about the slow reversal than the horizon-discriminating probe.
It does not address the slow-horizon identifiability ambiguity.
